scope: Phase-specific input fault contract and explicit final handshake. Functional and isolated synthesized evidence, not complete receiver timing or hardware qualification.

implementation.premise: Before admission the actual input checker is held in reset. Once all 512 input beats are checked, its slot is closed through final publication and ACK drain. No framing/delivery event or new certificate can then occur; duplicate job-start remains an immediate error.
implementation.guard: USE_PHASE_INPUT_FAULT defaults to zero. Only the actual realtime service opts into a predicate containing duplicate start, sticky checker/source faults, vendor events and fast quarantine. Idle/final/ACK use it only under the documented phase premise. Full active-input fault checks and exact sticky reason accumulation remain unchanged.
implementation.final_commit: Explicitly expands mailbox_accept AND return_last using the already-existing qualified-final branch. All same-edge final conditions remain; the nonfinal fault branch is not needlessly reconverged onto final occupancy and ACK controls.
implementation.service: Final input fence retains checked completion, sticky checker fault and same-edge duplicate-start veto. Checker epoch remains alive throughout ACK drain and quarantine.

coverage: Whole executable guard/service token whitelist against af96c48e, preserving all other logic.

Actual unchanged input checker, identity checking disabled/enabled, 512 real delivered beats, 32768 completed-phase pin rows including 16384 duplicate rows in each mode; four/five premature-fault witnesses and common-reset/new-job recovery. No private-state deposits.
